gen-zen-dots-gf-cantarell: Spacious and techy up top, Zen Dots leaves generous room around each letter, with Cantarell below holding its c tips well apart. Its arches match its stems, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-zen-dots-gf-catamaran: Catamaran keeps its letters curvy and unclamped, a friendly counterweight to Zen Dots, whose shapes sit in generous room. And paragraphs of it flow easily, with nothing sharp to snag the eye.
gen-zen-dots-gf-didact-gothic: Reading never snags in Didact Gothic, where no bowl closes up and each stroke carries the same visual weight. Didact Gothic handles the steady text work, while Zen Dots brings the techy, friendly display energy.
gen-zen-dots-gf-elms-sans: Zen Dots spreads generous room around every letter, a techy, friendly display face that stays open at every weight. Elms Sans meets it with a ballpoint's pressure-free line and a see-through gap in each s.
gen-zen-dots-gf-encode-sans-semi-condens: Encode Sans Semi Condensed reads smoothly as a sans-serif, its open counter on the s keeping each line legible. Zen Dots supplies the techy, friendly display voice above it.
gen-zen-dots-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 reads in a clean, professional way, its curves leaving plenty of daylight inside each letter. Zen Dots lends the display lines above it a techy, friendly voice.
gen-zen-dots-gf-fahkwang: Contemporary in feel, Fahkwang adds a faint nib-pressure variation to round letters, with curves that finish well before they close. Zen Dots stays low in contrast and lets Fahkwang's moderate shift follow.
gen-zen-dots-gf-fustat: Rope-like and bendy, Fustat draws lines like tubing with no thick-thin shift and a wide gap where the c ends. Zen Dots, low in contrast too, gives it a techy, friendly headline partner.
gen-zen-dots-gf-gayathri: Approachable first, Gayathri leaves every curved letter open-ended. Zen Dots handles the techy, spacious display work with low contrast, while Gayathri brings the mild thick-thin variation of a letterpress slug.
gen-zen-dots-gf-google-sans: Zen Dots gives its letters generous room and low contrast, a techy, friendly display voice. Google Sans follows with terminals pulled well back and no thick-thin shift in its outlines.
